name: CodeQL: Autobuild
description: Attempt to automatically build the code. Only used for analyzing languages that require a build. Use the `build-mode: autobuild` input in the `init` action instead.

token.description: GitHub token to use for authenticating with this instance of GitHub. The token needs the `security-events: write` permission.

working-directory.description: Run the autobuilder using this path (relative to $GITHUB_WORKSPACE) as working directory. If this input is not set, the autobuilder runs with $GITHUB_WORKSPACE
